mapper.update: update ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_plus_info set used_amount = used_amount + #{param.usedAmout},total_amount = total_amount + #{param.totalAmount} where user_id = #{param.userId}

update ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_plus_info
thali_type = #{param.thaliType},
thali_starttime = #{param.thaliStarttime},
thali_endtime = #{param.thaliEndtime},
used_amount = #{param.usedAmount},
total_amount = #{param.totalAmount},
earn_points = #{param.earnPoints},
thali_status = #{param.thaliStatus},
red_grantnum = #{param.redGrantnum},
plus_equity = #{param.plusEquity},
red_grantmonth = #{param.redGrantmonth},
expiration_notice = #{param.expirationNotice},
where user_id = #{param.userId}
mapper.select: select thali_type,used_amount ,plus_equity from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_plus_info where user_id = #{userId} and thali_status = 1

select pt.thali_id,pt.thali_type,pt.thali_price,pi.plus_equity as thaliEquity,pt.thali_recommend,pt.thali_status, pi.thali_endtime,pi.total_amount,pi.renewal_display,pi.thali_status as memberStatus,pi.earn_points,ui.user_name,thali_oldPrice,uid.user_avatar from ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_merchant_plus_thali pt left join ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_plus_info pi on pi.thali_type = pt.thali_type left join ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info ui on ui.user_id = pi.user_id left join ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info_detail uid on uid.user_id = ui.user_id where pi.user_id = #{userId} and pi.thali_status = 1

select plus_id,pi.user_id,thali_starttime ,thali_type,thali_endtime,used_amount,total_amount, creat_time,earn_points,thali_status,plus_equity,ui.user_name from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_plus_info pi left join ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info ui on ui.user_id = pi.user_id where thali_status = 1 and now() >= thali_endtime

select renew_id,thali_type,user_id,renew_starttime,renew_endtime,plus_equity,renew_status,plus_orderid from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_plus_renew where user_id = #{userId} and renew_status = 0 order by renew_starttime asc limit 1

select equity_id,equity_name,equity_type,equity_value,equity_addtime,equity_status, red_effective,red_provide,discount_limit from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_plus_equity where equity_id in
#{id} and equity_type in (2,3,4)

select plus_id,pi.user_id,thali_starttime ,thali_type,thali_endtime,used_amount,total_amount, creat_time,earn_points,thali_status,plus_equity,ui.user_name,red_grantnum,red_grantmonth from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_plus_info pi left join ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info ui on ui.user_id = pi.user_id where used_amount != 0

SELECT plus_id, pi.user_id, thali_starttime, thali_type, thali_endtime, used_amount, total_amount, creat_time, earn_points, thali_status, plus_equity, ui.user_name, red_grantnum, red_grantmonth FROM ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_plus_info pi LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info ui ON ui.user_id = pi.user_id WHERE thali_status = 1 AND red_grantnum > 0 AND #{month} >= red_grantmonth
